profile_text.body:
On its website, Lumen Technologies describes itself as a provider of global fiber networking, secure networking, edge cloud, and AI-ready infrastructure. The company says its fiber footprint supports low latency and real-time performance, and it presents itself as the enterprise-ready backbone of the AI economy. The site highlights work with Arctic Glacier, the New York Yankees, American Family Care, and Prometheus Hyperscale. For American Family Care, it describes building a private, low-latency network for heavy AI workloads. It also states that Prometheus Hyperscale anticipates cutting power consumption by 50% while keeping performance steady.

Public records list Lumen Technologies, Inc. as a for-profit public company headquartered in Monroe, Louisiana, with SEC CIK number 0000018926 and ticker symbol LUMN. Louisiana court records show 57 cases involving the company.
